review_scope: Source question-body crop fidelity. Separate preparation and independent review inspected full source pages and all actual output parts. External answer scoring and neighboring questions excluded; original body notation and figures preserved.
limitations: Not answer recertification, original-source completeness, accessible transcription or redistribution authorization. Browser QA remains blocked.

independent_review.scope: Crop boundaries and faithful rendering of available third-party source only. Not original completeness, transcription, answers, keys, or distribution rights.
findings: Independently inspected all nine full page renders and all 25 actual-output contact sheets; all 88 records and 145 parts are represented.
Objectives Q1–Q50 preserve stems, options, diagrams and cross-column/page continuations: Q5, Q9, Q15, Q20, Q30, Q38, Q44 and Q49. No section instructions or header/footer text intrude.

Descriptive printed groups 51–70 correctly map to normalized Q51–Q88, including split (i)/(ii) cut alternatives, parameter passing cases, architecture leaves and SQL leaves. Stored printed_question_number labels 3–22 differ from reproduction labels; no metadata correction or original numbering certification is implied.

All available relevant source content is retained. Detached marks for Q53/Q55, Q56/Q57, Q73 and Q81 remain separate parts. Q55 retains explicitly referenced preceding proofs, and Q66 retains the explicitly referenced termination result.

All 34 positive-area overlaps were independently recomputed and checked visually. Every overlap is an identical rectangle for a shared parent label, common definition/figure/program, shared marks, or explicit prerequisite. No other overlaps or unrelated sibling-question leaks were found.
The full graph is preserved for Q56–Q59; shared HALTS/FUNNY code, parameter program, assembly comments, segmented paging assumptions and EMP/DEPT relations are present for their dependent leaves.
Q71 table and Q78/Q79 assembly comments approach the right page border; the retained border sliver is acceptable to preserve visible content.
Native blur, compressed formulas, Q64 unclear/missing grammar radix point, Q81–Q83 216 exponent appearance and other source notation damage are preserved without reconstruction.
Source SHA-256 matches canonical crop-source-map and preparation audit. All 145 images freshly rendered at 3x WEBP quality 80 match both saved image bytes and recorded hashes.
limitations: MuPDF reports missing Fm0 XObject resources. Available rendered content can be reviewed, but missing resources prevent certifying that it contains all original exam material.
Third-party reproduction provenance and original completeness remain unresolved. Approval is crop-boundary approval only.
